'''Kend Harlow''' was a gambler indebted to the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] crimelord [[Hatabbas]]. In exchange for payment, the Rodian forced Harlow to fight his pet [[Svaper/Legends|svaper]]; if he won he could go free, if he failed he would die. Harlow was unable to defeat the beast, and was consumed in battle.
